postgresData: New owned service explicitly uses192MiB tmpfs; Docker metadata/images use the measured NVMe device.
decision: Require180 stable seconds of low CPU/memory and actual backing-storage activity, then two fresh15-second acceptable samples per job. Elevated global I/O PSI/iowait is retained with unresolved provenance. No attribution to graphics is proven.
basis: Four15-second measurements show CPU6.2–7.0%, NVMe1.3–2.85% utilization, low queue and zero sampled inflight. A separate reviewer assessed this as defensible with sustained monitoring and bounded serial isolation.
criticalContention: Three consecutive15-second critical samples terminate only the owned validation job; normal headroom loss withholds the next job. Timeouts/assertions unchanged.
